mapper.select: SELECT LEVEL, C.ONETALK_NO, C.ONETALK_CONTENT, C.ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, C.MEMBER_NO, C.MEMBER_NAME, C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO, C.ONETALK_DEL_FL, C.WORKER_NICKNAME, C.BUSINESS_NAME FROM ( SELECT O.ONETALK_NO, O.ONETALK_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(O.ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') AS ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, O.MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_NAME, O.PARENT_ONETALK_NO, O.ONETALK_DEL_FL, W.WORKER_NICKNAME, E.BUSINESS_NAME FROM "ONETALK" O LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "WORKER" W ON O.MEMBER_NO = W.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" E ON O.MEMBER_NO = E.MEMBER_NO ) C WHERE C.ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N' OR 0 != ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.ONETALK_NO AND SUB.COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N' ) START WITH C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR C.ONETALK_NO = C.PARENT_ONETALK_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY C.ONETALK_NO
